candidate_windows.window_text: We limited training models to three epochs because several studies indicate that training language models for many epochs can worsen performance on downstream tasks and does not significantly reduce validation loss (Xue et al., 2024; Muennighoff et al., 2024). We trained each model using a single seed for each task, resulting in a total of 26 models. Except for the experiments in Section 4.5, training took less than a day with a single NVIDIA RTX A5000 or A6000. For the experiments in Section 4.5, we trained each model on a single server equipped with 8 H100 GPUs for a maximum of three days.
